## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 15, 2026 - Oct 19, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Melissa Hawley_, Oct 19, 2026, 1/5: "I have had this for a while and while using a Fitbit luxe worked well. I have just upgraded to a Fitbit versa 4 due to it having GPS, and lost the map feature for hikes. Researching this with the help of Gemini, all settings and permissions are correct and allowed, I did not pause the hike, logged out restarted the phone, and back in to refesh, it was due to an upgrade to the app, again broken by a further update 5.10.1. Very disappointed to lose this and paying for premium features."
            2. _Jim Steenbergen_, Sep 16, 2026, 1/5: "Having the same issues as Kimberly on 6/15. Every time I have to update phone the sync gets messed up and I have to leave on charger and start using my "fitbit charge 2" watch, which is much more reliable. Plus it no longer reads my O2 or EKG. only one light on back lights up, where there use to be 3 lights!!!"
            3. _Allison 'AJ' John_, Sep 16, 2026, 1/5: "Consistently stuck, never syncs. WORST Google app and I'm a big Google fan. They never should have shut down Fitbit until it was ready. This one is a glitchy joke."
